responsibility: General support module for Ada GCC-tree construction, attributes, and builtin installation. It maintains global GNAT-created decl tables, raise helper decls, target-dependent alignment settings, and numerous attribute handlers for Ada pragmas mapped onto GCC attributes, and it installs frontend/common/target builtin nodes using ada-builtins.def and ada-builtin-types.def, so the rest of gigi can create correctly attributed declarations and call the expected builtins.
